name: UniQueR
definition: A feedforward framework for fast 3D reconstruction from unposed images using sparse learnable 3D queries. It predicts camera-to-world transforms and per-view local point maps, then uses queries to spawn Gaussians rendered via differentiable splatting for supervision.
summary: UniQueR is a feedforward framework for fast 3D reconstruction from unposed images that decouples Gaussian prediction from pixels using learnable implicit tokens to avoid quadratic attention complexity.
